sources.entry: Asset Catalog Tinkerer - App that lets you open .car files and browse/extract their images.

summary.one_liner: A macOS app for opening compiled asset catalog (.car) and theme store files to browse, copy, and export the images inside them.
summary.what_it_does: Opens .car asset catalog files and displays the images they contain. Individual images can be copied or dragged out, and the whole catalog or selected images can be exported to a directory. Since version 2.2 it also reads theme store files, such as the UI component assets in SystemAppearance.bundle and ProKit/LunaKit theme stores inside pro apps. The README says the app includes a QuickLook plug-in so asset catalog previews work in QuickLook.
use_cases: Extract images from an app's compiled Resources .car file
Browse assets inside macOS system appearance bundles
Export all images from an asset catalog to a folder
Pull out UI theme images from ProKit or LunaKit theme stores
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the project's releases page, or
Install with Homebrew: brew install asset-catalog-tinkerer
Open a .car file in the app and drag assets out or export them to a directory
notable: Reads compiled .car asset catalogs without needing the original source files
Includes a QuickLook plug-in for previewing asset catalogs
Supports macOS theme store files, not just catalog files, since version 2.2
caveats: Designed for images only; modern asset types such as colors are not supported
The README says the app is also available for download via Gumroad, where contributions are optional
